description_en: You can invoke PickOutboundNumbers to select an appropriate caller number based on the provided callee number. The number selection logic is controlled by an Intelligent algorithm
description_zh: 调用PickOutboundNumbers根据传入的被叫号码选择适合的主叫号码，选号逻辑由智能算法控制
kebab_example: aliyun ccc pick-outbound-numbers --instance-id ccc-test --called-number 13888880000 --count 1 --skill-group-id-list skillgroup@ccc-test --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PickOutboundNumbers

parameters.help_en: The desired quantity of selectable numbers to return. Default is 1
parameters.help_zh: 希望返回的可选号码数量， 默认1
parameters.name: count

parameters.help_en: A collection of skill group IDs, formatted as a JSON array string. Each array element is a skill group ID. Numbers are associated with skill groups, and this parameter specifies from which skill groups to select numbers
parameters.help_zh: 技能组ID集合，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素是技能组ID，号码与技能组是关联的，此参数用于指定从哪些技能组挑选号码
parameters.name: skill_group_id_list
